audience: coworking space managers who run memberships, bookings and check-ins in Cobot

useCases.title: Find a member and review their check-ins
useCases.text: Search memberships by name, company or email. List the check-ins of one membership in a time range.

useCases.title: Find an available resource for a time slot
useCases.text: List the resources of the space. Check when one resource is available, then list the bookings in that time range.

useCases.title: Book a resource for a membership
useCases.text: Check the resource availability first. Then book the resource for a membership, which creates a booking.

useCases.title: Check a member in or out
useCases.text: Check a member in with their check-in token. Check out a membership that is checked in at the space.

useCases.title: Review invoices for a date range
useCases.text: List the invoices of the space, filtered by member, date range or paid status. Open one invoice to read its details.

useCases.title: Open a help desk issue
useCases.text: Open a help desk issue in the space for a fault or a request. Members open it as themselves.
